report.title: Research report
report.subtitle: Question methods findings and implications
report.introduction: Use this report to document a defined research question, the evidence examined and the findings it supports. Replace the instructional text with reviewed content and cite the source for each result.
report.summary: State the research question and principal finding. Explain why it matters, the population or setting examined, and the limits of the available evidence.
report.detail: Describe the study design, source data, collection period, preparation and analysis. Include the information needed to understand the result and reproduce the essential method.
report.scope: Describe inclusion and exclusion criteria, uncertainty and any limits on interpretation. Separate planned work from completed analysis.

pages.name: Identity
pages.title: University of Northern British Columbia
pages.subtitle: One complete official logo for documents and external audiences.

elements.text: The original university logo is retained as fixed vector artwork. Use the complete logo on official documents and material intended for external audiences.
This kit pairs official identity resources with local editable applications. Local page layouts do not establish university approval of a report or a departmental logo.
SOURCE: GRAPHICS STANDARDS MANUAL / PAGES 2 AND 18

pages.name: Size and clear space
pages.title: Size the artwork and protect its space
pages.subtitle: Official minimum width and geometric clear-space rule.

elements.text: Full logo: at least 38.1 mm (1.5 inches) wide. Width refers to visible artwork, excluding any surrounding blank space. Preserve the original aspect ratio.

On every side, reserve the difference between the top of B and the top of N. The supplied SVG measures approximately 0.03691 × full logo width: a 55 mm logo needs at least 2.03 mm clear. Documents reserve 8 mm as a local layout default.
SOURCE: MANUAL PAGES 3–4 / NUMERIC RATIO MEASURED FROM SOURCE ARTWORK

pages.name: Colour
pages.title: Use green white and black for the logo
pages.subtitle: Gold is an accent colour and never a logo colour.

elements.text: Green on white. White preferably on solid UNBC Green. Black only for black-only reproduction on white or a light ground. No tints or other logo colours.

pages.name: Department sub-logos
pages.title: One logo with the unit set beneath it
pages.subtitle: The construction of UNBC’s own sub-logos and door signs.

values.department:
Faculty of Human
and Health Sciences

elements.text: The unit’s name hangs under NORTHERN BRITISH COLUMBIA, aligned to its N, in Helvetica Neue 95 Black at the size and leading of the official sub-logos. Long names wrap; “and” and “&” open a line rather than end one. Names matched to UNBC’s artwork keep its exact breaks.
Use the established name of the unit. Never condense, stretch or rebuild the logo, and keep the full logo’s clear space and minimum width.

pages.name: Typography
pages.title: Helvetica Neue with Arial as the alternative
pages.subtitle: The logo always uses its original outlined artwork.

elements.text: Use the licensed face where it is available. UNBC encourages variation in weight within the family.

The kit sets its artwork in Helvetica Neue LT Pro: 55 Roman, 75 Bold and 95 Black for sub-logo department lines. Word and PowerPoint request Arial, since the font’s licence does not allow it to be embedded in an editable file.

pages.name: Reports and briefs
pages.title: Explain the question evidence and decision
pages.subtitle: Editable Letter and A4 applications for research and administration.

elements.text: Use the Documents editor for flowing reports, evidence figures, comparison tables, citations and editable Word masters. Use Templates for fixed stationery and graphic layouts.

pages.name: Brand portfolio
pages.title: Describe each relationship accurately
pages.subtitle: University units and independent organizations have different relationships.

elements.text: The portfolio records a unit or initiative, its purpose, audience, organizational relationship, identity resources and applications.
An existing UNBC lab identity in this kit. Its presence does not establish an approved departmental sub-logo.
An independent student newspaper associated with the UNBC community, not a university department.

pages.name: Presentations and digital
pages.title: Keep the same identity across applications
pages.subtitle: Local slide and announcement layouts preserve the university logo.

elements.text: Four editable slide layouts. Keep figures at a readable size, explain the evidence and retain source captions.
Official university templates are also included unchanged in official-templates/.

pages.title: Keep official sources alongside local applications
pages.subtitle: Original resources hashes and reproducible generators.

elements.text: Original university resources: full logo EPS/GIF files, official website vector, Graphics Standards Manual, two letterheads, two document covers and the PowerPoint template.

Local additions: report, decision brief and brand portfolio models; editable Letter and A4 stationery; four slide layouts; social announcement and HTML email signature; this guide and the portable consumer profile.

Source differences are recorded in reference/PROVENANCE.json. The website logo uses #00573D; generated artwork retains every original path but uses the manual’s #035642. The manual’s gold RGB 183,149,39 agrees with #B79527; the website table’s 183,149,3 does not.
Rebuild with npm run make:unbc. Review fonts, pagination and source content before sharing a finished document.

footer.name: University of Northern British Columbia
footer.acknowledgement: For thousands of years, Indigenous Peoples have walked gently on the diverse traditional territories where the University of Northern British Columbia community is grateful to live, work, learn, and play. We are committed to building and nurturing relationships with Indigenous Peoples and we acknowledge their traditional lands.
